brief:
Israel and the United States have launched joint planning for new military infrastructure to enable permanent stationing and deployment of American aircraft in Israel, according to Channel 12. The joint Israeli-American teams have begun designing the facilities needed to support ongoing American air operations from Israeli bases.

The development signals expanded military coordination between the two countries and reflects deepening defense integration in the region.

title: Israel and US plan permanent American military aircraft infrastructure
